seo.title: Restaurant in Oroslavje | Zagorje Cuisine – Hotel Zagi
seo.description: Hotel Zagi’s à la carte restaurant: Zagorje štrukli, turkey with mlinci, a Sunday buffet, celebrations, weddings and catering near Zagreb. Book a table.

hero.title: Restaurant Zagi – the flavours of Croatian Zagorje
hero.lead: Home-style Zagorje and international cooking, wines from our own winery and a table for every occasion.

image.alt: Festively laid table with candles, a rose and wine glasses

story.heading: Hospitality you remember
paragraphs: Our restaurant has two dining rooms and two terraces, where we host celebrations, weddings, christenings, business gatherings and all kinds of events.

Friendly, professional staff are the reason Restaurant Zagi is busy all year round – with guests from near and far, and with many companies, associations and sports clubs. We are always happy to adapt our food and drinks to your needs and wishes.

image.alt: Table detail with folded napkins, glasses and red candles

dishes.heading: Signature dishes
dishes.lead: We are especially proud of our rich choice of traditional Zagorje specialities.

items.name: Zagorje štrukli
items.text: A must – boiled or baked, made the way Zagorje has made them for generations.

image.alt: Baked Zagorje štrukli in a ceramic dish on a wooden board

items.name: Duck or turkey with mlinci
items.text: Roast poultry with homemade mlinci flatbread – the Sunday lunch we remember from childhood.

image.alt: Roast duck leg with homemade mlinci on a white plate

items.name: Zagorje soup
items.text: Warm, hearty and fragrant – or pumpkin soup, depending on the season.

image.alt: Zagorje soup in a deep white plate garnished with parsley

items.name: Zagorje platter
items.text: Local cured meats, cheeses and pickles – a great start or something to share.

image.alt: Zagorje platter with prosciutto, cheese and pickles on a wooden board

buffet.heading: Sunday lunch – buffet
paragraphs: Give the family a Sunday off from cooking – we will cook for you. The buffet is back, bigger and richer than ever: meat, fish, cold and hot specialities, side dishes, desserts, plus vegetarian and gluten-free options.
Reserve a table for your family and friends on +385 49 284 666 or +385 99 228 3919.
buffet.note: Prices valid for the season starting 20 September 2026.

image.alt: Generous buffet with cold cuts, salads and hot dishes

catering.heading: Your celebration, our care
paragraphs: We organise weddings, christenings, birthdays, anniversaries, business get-togethers and receptions – in the restaurant, on the terrace or as catering at your venue in Zagorje.
We tailor the menu, drinks and layout to your occasion and number of guests. Send us an enquiry with the date and number of people.

image.alt: Starters and cold cuts served on a buffet for a celebration

wine.heading: Wines from our own OPG Čmarec winery
paragraphs: Alongside our home cooking, we offer a wide selection of drinks and wines from our own OPG Čmarec winery – local produce in the kitchen and in the glass.

haccp.heading: Food health and safety – HACCP
paragraphs: The success of Hotel Zagi’s restaurant rests on a high-level HACCP system that ensures food health and safety. Maintaining and continuously improving this system is our priority.
